representations.name: fixed-endpoint colour--reserve incidence graph
representations.new_information: For every repeated colour, retain its zero-shore endpoints and the individual missing-pair tokens legal for that colour before any deficient family is selected.
representations.first_test: Rebuild the sharp parity cores: all g repeated colours must have legal neighbourhoods satisfying Hall, even when their token sets overlap maximally.

representations.name: transversal-matroid rank profile
representations.new_information: Retain every subfamily rank r(S)=|N(S)| rather than only the total reserve-union cardinality; deficient sets become exact dual certificates.
representations.first_test: Compare two incidence systems with the same total token union and colour count but different minimum Hall slack.

representations.name: precommitted gauge-fixed endpoint word
representations.new_information: Quotient the independent edge-flip gauge only after adjoining a root/orientation chosen from maximum-witness geometry, preserving cross-colour endpoint agreement.
representations.first_test: Test equivariance on one K2 colour class and on the 2K2 sharp recolouring under endpoint-swap automorphisms.

representations.name: coherent-star colour-token hypergraph
representations.new_information: Record each repeated colour together with all coherent zero shores and reserve tokens, so alternative star witnesses are not collapsed to one selected star.
representations.first_test: Construct the smallest two-star configuration whose legal token sets overlap and ask whether starwise expansion composes globally.

representations.name: three-budget capacitated flow network
representations.new_information: Keep A-missing rectangles, B-reserve pairs, and residual defect as typed capacities with colour demand nodes, preventing charges in different budgets from being silently reused.
representations.first_test: Feed the audited sharp core and the zero-star defect ledger into the network and verify that g units route only through actual reserve capacity.

representations.name: reserve-decorated parity stability energy
representations.new_information: Adjoin unpaid colour defect and Hall slack coordinates to the exact (a,h,u,T) parity remainder instead of discarding colour provenance after scalar optimization.
representations.first_test: Hold the scalar equality profile fixed while adversarially varying legal-token incidence; determine whether the energy detects Hall failure.

representations.name: alternating obstruction-chain state
representations.new_information: Track successive deficient colour sets, their coherent-star replacements, newly exposed reserve tokens, and a bounded lexicographic potential across witness changes.
representations.first_test: Search the two-colour/two-token incidence cycle for a return to the initial state without net potential increase.

representations.name: bounded-type local density profile
representations.new_information: Record densities of rooted coloured subgraphs around zero shores, including missing-pair incidences, as a possible flag-algebra certificate for branch infeasibility.
representations.first_test: Produce incidence decorations with identical bounded rooted densities but different global Hall deficit, or show the normal form forbids them.

representations.name: colour-conflict auxiliary graph
representations.new_information: Represent repeated colours as vertices and join colours whose endpoint geometry forces competition for the same reserve tokens.
representations.first_test: On the sharp 2K2 recolouring, compare the auxiliary graph with the actual reserve matching number.

representations.name: entropy of token provenance
representations.new_information: Measure how much endpoint-conditioned reserve choice remains for each repeated colour and how conditioning on other colours reduces it.
representations.first_test: Test two colours with identical singleton token support, where positive marginal information does not yield a joint injection.
